this information over the internet.\n\nI ACCEPT THESE TERMS\nREAD FULL DISCLAIMER\nTYPES OF RECORDS\n\nThe Clerk is the recorder of all instruments required or authorized to be recorded in one general series of “Official Records” books. Upon payment of the statutory fees, the Clerk records and indexes a variety of important documents, which in most cases are related to real estate.\n\nExamples of such documents include:\n\nDeeds\n\nMortgages\n\nLiens\n\nContracts\n\nAffidavits\n\nSubdivision Plats\n\nSurveys\n\nDeclarations of Condominium\n\nBills of Sale\n\nJudgments\n\nCertificates of Military Discharge\n\nDeclarations of Domicile\n\nLegal Descriptions\n\nSubdivision plat maps are available in the Official Records Department of the Clerk’s office. A subdivision name, block, and lot number identify plat descriptions.
